caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical lamp with a tall, transparent glass chimney positioned vertically atop a metal base that has a circular saucer-like shape, decorated with a beaded or ridged edge. Attached to the base on the right side by a curved metal arm is a cap-like snuffer with a long handle terminating in a loop. The snuffer is designed to cover the top of the lamp chimney when not in use. All objects in the drawing are rendered in grayscale pencil or ink, with shading and highlights used to indicate the glass’s transparency and the reflective surfaces of the metal elements. In the lower left corner, there is an inset zoom-in showing a detailed close-up of the lamp’s mechanical components where the chimney meets the metal base, illustrating additional details such as rivets and a possible adjustment knob. The composition is centered within a rectangular border, with ample margin on the surrounding beige or off-white paper.
title: Candlestick
